name: Emunet
summary: Small family-run ISP at the base of the Blue Mountains, 45 minutes west of Sydney ('Emunet Computing Australia', ACN 074 937 027); low-cost k56flex dialup and ISDN access plus email, web hosting and web design; contact David@EmuNet.com.au, ph (02) 4735 6670.

events.details: Dialup (k56flex) and ISDN access, email accounts, web page hosting and design for home and business members.
